notes.content: 1. Transfer students from community colleges must be GE-Certified or additional coursework will be required to meet CSUCI requirements. A maximum of 70 units can be transferred. 2. Students who have successfully completed a Registered Nursing program at a community college will be awarded 20 upper-division units for nursing courses completed at the community college upon passing the National Council Licensure Examination (NCLEX) - RN. 3. Admission Requirements: 1. Application - Apply to both the University and the Nursing Program. For more information, see Nursing Program website: https://nursing.csuci.edu/ 2. Prerequisite Courses - Specific courses listed in the major below 1. Grade Point Average (GPA) - An overall GPA of 2.5 or greater 3. License - Have, or be eligible to acquire, a valid California Registered Nurse (RN) license. 4. Degree - Be graduate of Board of Registered Nursing (BRN)-approved, pre-licensure degree program from an accredited educational institution. 5. Insurance/Health Clearance - Students in the nursing program required to have health insurance, demonstrate a sufficient immunization record consistent with that required of clinical placement in local health care agencies, and pass a physical examination. 6. Background Check/Drug Screening - Criminal background check and drug screening must be completed before clinical placement. 4. Special Grade Requirement: Nursing majors must attain grades of "C" or better in all courses. 5. For the B.S.N. Nursing major only, courses satisfying the CSU American Institutions Requirement are allowed to double-count with the General Education Area D (GE area 4) requirement.
notes.contentHtml:
1. Transfer students from community colleges must be GE-Certified or additional coursework will be required to meet CSUCI requirements. A maximum of 70 units can be transferred.

2. Students who have successfully completed a Registered Nursing program at a community college will be awarded 20 upper-division units for nursing courses completed at the community college upon passing the National Council Licensure Examination (NCLEX) - RN.

3. Admission Requirements:

1. Application - Apply to both the University and the Nursing Program. For more information, see Nursing Program website: https://nursing.csuci.edu/

2. Prerequisite Courses - Specific courses listed in the major below

1. Grade Point Average (GPA) - An overall GPA of 2.5 or greater

3. License - Have, or be eligible to acquire, a valid California Registered Nurse (RN) license.

4. Degree - Be graduate of Board of Registered Nursing (BRN)-approved, pre-licensure degree program from an accredited educational institution.

5. Insurance/Health Clearance - Students in the nursing program required to have health insurance, demonstrate a sufficient immunization record consistent with that required of clinical placement in local health care agencies, and pass a physical examination.

6. Background Check/Drug Screening - Criminal background check and drug screening must be completed before clinical placement.

4. Special Grade Requirement: Nursing majors must attain grades of "C" or better in all courses.

5. For the B.S.N. Nursing major only, courses satisfying the CSU American Institutions Requirement are allowed to double-count with the General Education Area D (GE area 4) requirement.
